desc: Shivdas, a devoted doctor and astrologer, overcomes life's challenges through unwavering faith in Lord Shiva, ultimately receiving divine blessings and salvation.

title: Farz
desc: ACP Arjun Singh and his brother-in-law Tayaji work for the police. Tayaji dies, leaving Arjun's family sad. Gawa Firozi and Sikander then scare the city.
